body:
Software zoom and fractional camera offsets currently send axis-aligned sprites and fills through SDL triangles. This change separates CPU raster operations, backend state, transient terrain preparation and completed-frame presentation, then routes sprites/fills directly to CPU surfaces. Native-scale output remains identical in the captured fixtures; fractional transforms use nearest-neighbor sampling with shared endpoint rounding.

The commits provide the optional saved-game benchmark, backend separation and content revisions, direct primitives, a bounded 32 MiB terrain LRU and water coverage, and rotating software framebuffers. Review fixes integrate current master's native display scaling and accelerated rectangle batching, remove redundant forwarding hooks, and correct profiling diagnostics. OpenGL/portable capabilities and simulation/save formats are preserved.

### Validation

Original-baseline measurements on Apple M3/macOS, seven alternating CPU pairs per scenario (240 frames, 30 warmup, 1280×800):

| Populated reference scenario | Baseline CPU ms/frame | Candidate | Speedup |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Half zoom | 17.574 | 2.234 | 7.87× |
| Double zoom | 9.160 | 1.324 | 6.92× |
| Fractional offset | 15.131 | 1.346 | 11.24× |

Four native-scale fixtures improved 21–34%, with exact captured RGBA equality. Isolated terrain caching improved half-zoom CPU about 6.7%; rotating buffers reduced visible-frame CPU about 3.4%. Raw distributions retain outliers and competing-build noise. These results were collected before rebasing onto newer upstream graphics settings; they establish the original optimization benefit, not a benchmark of current master.

- Original candidate: 19 focused software tests and 18 OpenGL-enabled tests passed on SDL2-compat 2.32.70 / SDL3 3.4.14.
- A 128-tick saved-game continuation produced identical per-tick checksums, replay bytes and decompressed final save against the original baseline.
- Fresh review agent found and verified integration fixes for accelerated-only rectangle batching and lazy native geometry ordering; final review reports no actionable findings. The rebased branch passes all 23 focused software tests, including native display scaling, target rotation, partial exposure and upstream point-bar rendering. All 28 OpenGL-enabled checks also passed. The final differently sized target-binding fix passed seven affected software lifecycle/portable cases and the OpenGL-enabled target regression. Platform CI remains queued/running and is not claimed as completed.
- Linux/Windows runtime and interactive maintainer playtesting remain unverified. CI compilation does not substitute for those checks.

The existing large-texture SDL geometry behavior is intentionally retained for enlarged owned water assets. Fractional sampling/rounding changes are the only intended visual effect; no gameplay changes or new settings/dependencies are introduced.

Generated profiles and captures stay out of this code branch. Reproduction commands and architecture are in `docs/development/reference.md`; the [evidence branch](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/codex/software-renderer-evidence) provides saves, raw logs, captures, exact baseline harness source and checksum comparisons. The benchmark fixes pixel dimensions independently of monitor density; native display profiling is opt-in.


### Rebased follow-up

Seven additional alternating pairs against the original baseline with fixed 1280×800 pixel targets show 5.82× faster half zoom, 5.82× double zoom, and 9.68× fractional offsets. Native reference CPU improved 28%; native and double captures remain pixel identical. This includes upstream graphics changes and concurrent debug-build noise, so it is a follow-up against the original baseline, not an isolated comparison to current master. Raw pairs and captures are in `profiles/pr-fixed-pixel-pairs` and `captures/pr-fixed-pixel-pairs` on the evidence branch.

The review commits have been consolidated into one focused final commit after the five planned implementation commits. No outstanding review findings remain. Platform, browser and mobile CI builds are still pending at this update; their eventual outcomes must be checked separately.
title: Speed up software rendering and separate raster, scene and presentation ownership
